ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.9 responds to the V0.4.8 JobGiver traces, which identified GenClosest, Reachability and RegionTraverser as the dominant long-tail work-search chain. The first V0.4.9 production step does not move CanReach, validators, reservations or final Job selection off-thread. Instead, for large stable custom global Thing lists, the main thread records an exact identity/position snapshot and a worker prepares a stable nearest-first candidate order for repeated roots. On a verified cache hit, all original candidates are passed back to Vanilla GenClosest, with original order preserved for equal-distance ties, allowing Vanilla to establish a close best-distance earlier and potentially avoid many later reachability checks. Any list membership/order/position change, unsupported call shape, stale worker result or compatibility ambiguity leaves the original candidate order untouched. V0.4.8 bounded slow-JobPackage tracing, V0.4.7/V0.4.6 hauling paths, Path shadow validation and the Butter++ logical-tick barrier are retained.
